listing.name: Go Go Ackman (Go Go Ackman Recompiled)
listing.summary: Use an already permitted Go Go Ackman v1.0 Windows player with your own exact Japanese ROM. The project combines compiled game code with an interpreter; full-game compatibility is unconfirmed. Fresh downloads remain conditional on permission for embedded translation content. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay. Linux Flatpak is a separate upstream package.

steps.title: Keep an already permitted complete native-host player
steps.instruction: Use an already permitted working v1.0 Windows x64 AckmanRecomp.exe with all matching files. Follow applicable project, framework and component terms, including noncommercial personal-use restrictions. The source combines compiled game code with an active interpreter and hardware core; how much runs natively and whether the full game matches the original are unconfirmed. Fresh downloads remain conditional on permission for the embedded English translation and translation metadata. Permission to use an existing private Japanese copy does not settle those separate rights.

steps.title: Preserve the exact owned Japanese original
steps.instruction: Use your own Go Go Ackman Japanese SNES ROM, unheadered 1,310,720 bytes / upstream SHA256 e8a33b6c8e15cf0aa60e9694471a51926fb97ad895d4714384c6abff28a33a1f. Upstream normalizes an optional 512-byte header and verifies the original. Complete the official picker and a working normal launch outside Portcove. English/PT-BR translations, IPS conversion, native mod packages and external MSU/audio have separate inputs/rights; Portcove does not obtain patches or translated ROMs, or confirm their compatibility.

steps.title: Select the normal supervised application
steps.instruction: Select AckmanRecomp.exe with its established writable installation folder as the working directory. A configured copy needs no arguments for normal ROM selection. If your working setup already requires --config with an absolute path or a ROM argument, keep each option, path and value as a separate argument, preserving spaces inside paths. The normal application waits for its game and recovery processes. Do not select private child, watchdog or restart flags, build scripts or diagnostic modes to bypass that behavior. Saving launch details does not prepare or start the game.

steps.title: Review intent and keep recovery upstream-owned
steps.instruction: Review and consent to the selected executable, working directory and arguments, then choose Play separately. Portcove tracks the selected process; it does not isolate the game’s files or prevent other instances. You and upstream manage setup, profiles, repairs and updates. Shader, driver or mod changes can restart the game’s child process, restore checkpoints or use backup configurations; the application waits for its child, while Portcove tracks the selected application. Complete recovery through upstream tools, close every real instance, keep the previous working copy and data, then relink and review a changed executable. Removing the registration leaves all external files in place.

steps.title: Retain the complete creating profile and all recovery data
steps.instruction: Keep the whole runtime/original and actual config.ini/custom --config, rom/ and external original path, saves/slots/custom states/GGA1_autosave.sav and emergency checkpoints, mods/native packages/MSU audio/player edits, shaders, screenshots, logs/status files, fallback configuration backups and all unknown/custom files. Windows writable assets/profile use the actual executable-side root; changing CWD alone is not a profile redirect. This cartridge declares no battery SRAM; native states are not interchangeable emulator saves. Keep state/mod/recovery history with its creating build. Metadata removal preserves every external byte.

warnings: Follow the project and framework’s PolyForm Noncommercial terms and component notices. They do not grant rights to the original ROM or external translations and audio. The selected source includes an English translation table and English/PT-BR metadata; PT-BR metadata does not confirm an embedded full PT-BR patch. Portcove has not inspected the package or resolved those separate component permissions.

Release v1.0 also names an experimental game build. The source combines compiled code with an interpreter; Portcove has not measured native execution or tested gameplay, saves, states, mods, stability or installed behavior. Keep upstream’s interpreter fallback and recovery features intact.

Portcove does not download, extract, translate, build, install, update, back up, roll back, migrate or delete this external copy. Permission to use an existing private copy does not settle permission for a new download’s components.
